BMW model
Original source title: [FREE] BMW M3 E30

Optimized GLB distributed by ahnuchen/auto-atlas, commit cb039d767f549e4d032ae8a704117a3979d3adfa:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ahnuchen/auto-atlas/cb039d767f549e4d032ae8a704117a3979d3adfa/public/models/free_bmw_m3_e30.glb
SHA256: 4806a9b24954a784efc349b6b2ab2b0c347f3802422f1baf1054f45e44a933d1
Creator/license verified from original public metadata:
https://api.sketchfab.com/v3/models/ac3c7013434e403e8faff87948caf422

Changes in this project (both models): coordinate rotation and recentering, uniform wheelbase scaling, articulated wheels, material/paint adjustments, and attachment of separate virtual propulsion/suspension hardware. BMW's parked steering pose is straightened. Source GLB binaries are retained unchanged; transformations occur at runtime. The BMW distributor has already optimized the source for the web.

All original creators retain copyright in their respective models. Model licenses do not imply endorsement by their authors or the vehicle manufacturers. Existing Roadster attribution remains in assets/tesla-roadster-2020 and the application source panel.
